Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Laura Wolvaardt and Anneke Bosch to open for South Africa Women. Renuka Singh to bowl first.
...THIRD INNINGS.

Once India got the two big Proteas wickets, it was just a procession after that. Sneh Rana was the star of the show. She finished with 8 wickets while the other two went to Deepti Sharma. Now, South Africa Women are way behind the 8-ball game. They need to restart! But the cracks have opened up and it's just going to be hard for the visitors. India have their tails up. They are up for the task. Will we see a result today itself? Let's find out.

So, South Africa Women are bowled out for 266. INDIA HAVE ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON! Sneh Rana finishes with 8 wickets. She was up for Day 3. South Africa Women just added 30 runs to the overnight score as once they lost Marizanne Kapp and Nadine de Klerk today, they fell like a pack of cards. The pitch had turn on offer and Harmanpreet Kaur introduced spin straightaway from both ends. Sneh Rana and Deepti Sharma were in business right from the word go. Kapp and Nadine de Klerk started the day well but it didn't last long as Rana took the wickets of both the experienced campaigner.

OUT! BOWLED! Eight it is for Sneh Rana! What a moment for the spinner! Floated full and on off, Mlaba swings her bat but misses the ball, it rolls through and hits the stumps. South Africa Women finish with 266.

Hello and welcome to action of Day 3 between India and South Africa. The game is unfolding very nicely as South Africa grouped up to tackle India’s mammoth total and have been doing the job well so far. The openers got them off to a good start but it was Luus and Kapp’s partnership that helped the Proteas climb the ladder. Luus fell on 65 but Kapp is still on the crease and along with De Klerk have added 38 runs. For India, the ball has started to move and the spinners need to stay consistent today as they could be key for wickets. Let’s see how the session goes by. Stay tuned.
... Day 3, Session 1...

For India, Sneh Rana was the pick with a three-fer. She got the ball to turn and grip quite a lot and will be very pleased with her performance. The key for India will be to stay patient as the wicket has started to play tricks. They'll hope it wears more and they can get a few breakthroughs early on Day 3. That begins at 0930 IST (0400 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

They lost Laura Wolvaardt early but Bosch and Luus put up a good partnership to steady things. Bosch fell but Luus continued along with Kapp. They put up another good stand in which Luus got her fifty up. However, they lost two wickets in quick succession but Kapp and Nadine are amidst another good stand. They need to bat for a long time. Kapp will be looking for a ton whereas Nadine has started well. South Africa will hope for a big stand between the two.

THAT WILL BE STUMPS THEN! A hard fought day and South Africa will be pleased with their effort! They are still well behind in the game but they have shown good fight with the bat on a wicket which has started to play tricks now.
